complexity_classes.name: Focused
complexity_classes.semantics: One bounded artifact/module or deterministic edit with local tests; minimal shared-contract coupling.

complexity_classes.name: Bounded multi-file
complexity_classes.semantics: Several related files/tools with clear interfaces and low uncertainty.

complexity_classes.name: Cross-cutting bounded
complexity_classes.semantics: Touches shared governance/contracts or several modules but has known semantics and finite evidence.

complexity_classes.name: Evidence/data dependent
complexity_classes.semantics: Requires multi-domain design, source/data evidence, architecture choice or broader integration.

complexity_classes.name: Protected/high-risk
complexity_classes.semantics: Touches PIT/leakage/promotion/BAS/shared target semantics, protected evaluation, or dependency-critical gates; requires serialized review/evidence.

phases.name: Foundation
phases.objective: Materialize governed source evidence, canonical/PIT state, feature lifecycle, team state and strong reproducible baseline capability.
phases.entry_gate: W06 replan cleared; W07 identity contracts frozen
phases.exit_gate: PIT-safe national foundation and baseline evidence are implementable/replayable; source-dependent assumptions revalidated.

phases.name: Advanced Football Intelligence
phases.objective: Add player, roster, availability, transfers, coaching, context and game-mechanics intelligence with uncertainty-aware missingness.
phases.entry_gate: PHASE-1 canonical/PIT contracts stable enough for advanced states
phases.exit_gate: Advanced football state contracts are PIT-safe and can be ablated against foundation baselines.

phases.name: Texas A&M Specialization
phases.objective: Create disproportionately high-resolution A&M state, specialization, calibration, BAS science and A&M-specific evaluation without replacing national truth.
phases.exit_gate: A&M specialization and BAS are scientifically specified, leakage-safe and independently evaluable.

phases.name: Production & Autonomy
phases.objective: Make selected models/evaluation/research/weekly orchestration/product/operations reproducible, governed and locally operable.
phases.entry_gate: Model/validation contracts and starter implementation available
phases.exit_gate: End-to-end pregame forecasts can be regenerated, monitored, served and governed through immutable snapshots.

phases.name: Advanced Research & Finalization
phases.objective: Provide gated challenger/live research, full replay/readiness challenge and final Codex handoff without destabilizing proven baselines.
phases.entry_gate: Strong simple baselines and protected evaluation framework exist
phases.exit_gate: W24 readiness/architecture challenge complete and W25 canonical handoff is internally consistent.

epics.title: Comprehensive data-universe research
epics.objective: Revalidate and expand the source universe, licensing/PIT feasibility, source priorities and fallbacks using fresh research.

epics.title: Canonical entities and identity resolution
epics.objective: Define canonical identity, source mappings, temporal identity and unresolved-resolution workflow.

epics.title: Point-in-time state architecture
epics.objective: Implement the temporal semantics that make historical forecasts reconstructible without future information.

epics.title: Raw feature registry and schema discovery
epics.objective: Build schema discovery and feature metadata so raw fields are classified before engineering/promotion.

epics.title: Feature engineering and lifecycle
epics.objective: Create PIT-safe transforms, screening, ablation and promotion/demotion workflow.

epics.title: Team state and early-season intelligence
epics.objective: Build strength state, priors, recency, regime and lower-division hierarchy with uncertainty.

epics.title: Foundation baseline model capability
epics.objective: Establish simple and boosted national baselines, calibration and walk-forward benchmarks before complex challengers.

epics.title: Foundation implementation realization
epics.objective: Create functional starter adapters/contracts/storage/entity/PIT/feature implementations from the latest accepted designs.

epics.title: Player, roster, depth and availability state
epics.objective: Represent player value, depth, availability, usage, replacement and uncertainty at prediction time.

epics.title: Transfers, recruiting and prospect priors
epics.objective: Translate incoming talent/production across competitive context without hard-coded conference penalties.

epics.title: Coaching and staff intelligence
epics.objective: Represent effective-dated role episodes, development residuals, scheme/tendency and decision evidence with partial pooling.

epics.title: Environment, resources, venue and travel context
epics.objective: Represent environment and resource signals without inventing private-school values or hard-coded home bonuses.

epics.title: Possession, field position and special teams mechanics
epics.objective: Represent opportunity volume, hidden yards and specialists as separable candidate subsystems.

epics.title: Opponent adjustment, style and schedule stress
epics.objective: Normalize performance by opponent quality and represent matchup/style/workload context.

epics.title: Advanced intelligence implementation realization
epics.objective: Implement selected advanced state/feature components behind stable PIT-safe interfaces.

epics.title: Texas A&M high-resolution state
epics.objective: Define deeper A&M roster/unit/regime/matchup state while preserving one canonical truth.

epics.title: A&M specialization architecture
epics.objective: Compare residual, hierarchical multi-task, stacking and other specialization forms without forcing a nonzero adjustment.

epics.title: Scientific BAS labels and cross-fitting
epics.objective: Formalize leakage-safe performance residuals and BAS severity labels.

epics.title: BAS decomposition and statistical validation
epics.objective: Evaluate Aggie Excess, peer/regime/component hypotheses without hard-coding fan narratives.

epics.title: A&M specialization and BAS starter implementation
epics.objective: Implement selected specialization/BAS interfaces and integrate them with coherent forecast assembly.

epics.title: Model targets, joint score and simulation
epics.objective: Build coherent outcome-distribution architecture for win/loss/score/margin/BAS rather than disconnected point predictions.

epics.title: Uncertainty, OOD and market lanes
epics.objective: Separate pure-football and timestamp-safe market-augmented forecasts and expose uncertainty without unsupported directional claims.

epics.title: Validation, benchmarking and promotion science
epics.objective: Protect chronological evaluation and promotion rules before protected results are observed.

epics.title: Experimentation and autonomous research system
epics.objective: Build a governed experiment queue that can propose/run challengers without changing its own judging rules.

epics.title: Model, calibration and forecast starter implementation
epics.objective: Implement selected baseline/boosting/score/calibration/ensemble/uncertainty interfaces without fabricated performance.

epics.title: Autonomous weekly MLOps
epics.objective: Create resumable ingestion→QA→state→features→train→evaluate→promote→forecast→postmortem workflows.

epics.title: API, dashboard and forecast product
epics.objective: Serve immutable forecast snapshots with lineage, explanation, uncertainty, BAS and availability context.

epics.title: CI/CD, security, observability and local operations
epics.objective: Harden the local production path using measured operational needs rather than cargo-cult infrastructure.

epics.title: Advanced challenger framework
epics.objective: Allow neural/sequence/graph/other challengers only after strong baselines and protected evaluation exist.

epics.title: Future live/in-game research lane
epics.objective: Research chronological live replay without allowing live state into the same game pregame feature row.

epics.title: End-to-end readiness and source refresh
epics.objective: Replay the integrated system, refresh source assumptions and challenge architecture before final consolidation.

epics.title: Final consolidation and Codex handoff
epics.objective: Audit all requirements/ADRs/data/PIT/features/models/acceptance and deliver the final canonical repository and implementation priority.

epics.title: Program governance, packaging and adaptive control
epics.objective: Maintain cumulative integrity, stable IDs, acceptance evidence, architecture conformance and adaptive replanning across all implementation waves.
